summary: A 36-year-old Denver man died after a direct lightning strike to his upper body on Bear Creek Trail near Boulder; his 37-year-old wife was injured by ancillary current; the man was airlifted to a hospital and pronounced dead
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff, Rocky Mountain Fire Protection District, Rocky Mountain Rescue, AMR Ambulance, Boulder Fire Department
notes: Two-hour rescue; bystander CPR and AED attempted on scene; victim briefly revived before dying at hospital; one fatality and one injured survivor
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Flagstaff Mountain)
